description.zh-CN: 侧边栏多一个「AI 助手」页：用自然语言查片库、看采集与下载状态、开关扩展包、启停采集。模型走 OpenAI 兼容接口，由包自己直连，应用不新增任何后端能力。
description.en: Adds an AI Assistant page: query the library, read collect and download status, toggle packs, start or stop collection in natural language. Talks to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint itself.
